title: Henry V at the embarkation area
description: An optional bounded observation start for Henry V in the broad Portchester/Solent embarkation setting before departure on 11 August 1415. It supplies no exact berth, ship occupancy, hour, possessions or command authority.
requirements: Existing Henry V; reviewed 1415 individual start; explicit selection of this opening.

review.basis: Dan Spencer's 3–9 August summary places Henry at Portchester and explicitly records disagreement between the Gesta's 7 August boarding account and Patent Roll evidence suggesting he left the castle at least four days later. His 10–16 August summary records preparation/departure on 11 August and the assembled shipping in the Solent/Portchester harbour. Only the common broad embarkation setting is selected.
review.excluded: No particular room, berth, vessel occupancy, hour, fleet strength, readiness, loading state, health, possessions, introductions, received orders, institutional mandate, destination disclosure or subsequent departure/landing is initialized.
review.observation_rule: One explicitly selected 20-second local observation, using the existing Core scene handler. This is a bounded simulation rule, not a historical measured duration or a universal perception rule.
review.rights: Original summaries and mechanical configuration with citations; no article, image or archive is reproduced.

sources.title: Dan Spencer, 3–9 August 1415: Violence in Salisbury, the Trial of the Southampton Plotters and the embarkation of the Army
sources.locator: Final historical paragraph, comparing Gesta boarding account and Patent Roll dating; cites Anne Curry pp. 53–54 and Rymer, Foedera vol. 9 pp. 298–310.
sources.uncertainty: Boarding date and exact within-day location are unresolved; the start does not choose between castle, barge and ship.

sources.title: Dan Spencer, 10–16 August 1415: The expedition sets sail to France!
sources.locator: Opening paragraphs on 11 August preparation and shipping in the Solent/Portchester harbour. Later crossing/landing and reconstructed numbers are excluded.
